seed.name: Grid Watch
seed.text: Formation lap is a crawl and someone already locked up into T1 in my head. Dummy weekend. No live timing. Lights out when the paddock says so.

snippet.text: Tire blankets off too early. I called the stall from the couch.

seed.name: DRS Detect
seed.text: DRS detect on the main straight and half the field still cannot pass. This zone is a rumor. Dummy overtakes only.

seed.name: Box Box Box
seed.text: BOX BOX BOX and they sent him out on the same compound. Pit-lane mixup of the dummy year. The second car in the double stack waited like it was a drive-through.

snippet.text: Plan B was the same compound. We are checking.

seed.name: VSC Watch
seed.text: VSC, then SC, then VSC again. Race control is playing scales. Dummy chatter, not a timing feed. The delta is a suggestion.

seed.name: Undercut Now
seed.text: Undercut window is open for three cars and nobody is taking it. I am screaming at the TV like I have a radio. Dummy strategy only.

seed.name: Formation Lap
seed.text: Formation lap tire temps look nervous. If P1 lights go out and someone stalls, I called it from the couch. Dummy grid. No live lights.

snippet.text: Saw the lockup in my soul before T1.

seed.name: DNF Log

snippet.text: I told you the window was open. Nobody boxed.
